## Lisbon Trip Snapshot: 4 Days for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

A balanced Lisbon plan for **2026-05-14 to 2026-05-17** with **moderate walking**, a **museum-and-seafood focus**, and **one relaxed day**. I’m assuming you want to stay in a central neighborhood and use a mix of walking, tram, metro, and occasional taxis.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget Fit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and riverside welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and keep it light with a coffee and pastel de nata stop in **Baixa**.
- Afternoon: Explore **Praça do Comércio**, **Rua Augusta**, and **Chiado**; add a short stop at **Carmo Convent** if energy is good.
- Dinner: Seafood dinner in **Cais do Sodré** or **Chiado**; look for grilled fish, arroz de marisco, or bacalhau.
- Budget target: **€180–€220** for both, including meals, local transport, and light entry fees.

Day 2: Belém museums and monuments
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and **MAAT** or the **National Coach Museum**.
- Afternoon: Walk the riverside to **Belém Tower** and **Monument to the Discoveries**, then pause for a slow coffee break.
- Dinner: Stay in **Belém** or return to central Lisbon for a seafood-focused dinner.
- Budget target: **€190–€240** for both, driven by museum tickets and a sit-down dinner.

Day 3: Relaxed pace in Alfama and the river hills
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: Start late with a tram or taxi into **Alfama** and visit **Lisbon Cathedral** or a small museum if desired.
- Afternoon: Keep the pace easy with viewpoints, a long lunch, and optional **Fado** museum or a gentle riverfront stroll.
- Dinner: Book a classic seafood restaurant in **Alfama** or nearby **Mouraria**.
- Budget target: **€160–€210** for both, with lower transport and a flexible activity level.

Day 4: Parque das Nações or a final museum day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Choose **Parque das Nações** for an easy, modern waterfront walk or use the day for one last museum such as **Museu Nacional do Azulejo**.
- Afternoon: Do souvenir shopping, a final café stop, and an early return to pack.
- Dinner: Farewell seafood meal near **Baixa**, **Cais do Sodré**, or **Bairro Alto** if you want a livelier last night.
- Budget target: **€170–€220** for both, depending on museum choice and dinner style.

## Neighborhood Picks for Your Stay
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

| Neighborhood | Best for | Walking level | Why it fits |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Baixa | First-time visitors, easy transit, central access | Moderate | Flat, convenient, good for short walks and easy dining |
| Chiado | Museums, cafés, shopping, central base | Moderate | Stylish and walkable, close to many sights |
| Cais do Sodré | Restaurants, transport, river access | Moderate | Great for seafood and tram/metro connections |
| Avenida da Liberdade | Comfortable hotels, quieter nights | Low to moderate | Good if you want a calmer base with easy access |
| Alfama | Historic atmosphere, views, Fado | Higher | Beautiful, but hills and cobblestones make walking more demanding |

Recommended base: **Chiado** or **Baixa** for the best balance of convenience, dining, and moderate walking.

## Rough Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

| Category | 4-day estimate | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | €420–€560 | Mid-range central hotel or apartment, 3 nights |
| Food and drinks | €260–€340 | Mix of casual lunches, seafood dinners, coffee, and snacks |
| Local transport | €30–€60 | Metro, tram, and a few taxis if needed |
| Museums and entry fees | €90–€140 | 3–5 paid visits depending on your choices |
| Buffer / extras | €40–€80 | Souvenirs, extra dessert, small contingencies |
| Total | **€840–€1,180** | Best target: stay near **€900** by choosing moderate lodging and 2 nicer dinners |

Best way to stay near **€900 total**:
- Pick a **central 3-star hotel or apartment** around €140–€170 per night
- Keep lunch casual and make **2 dinners** the main seafood meals
- Use **metro/tram** instead of taxis except for one hill-heavy transfer
- Choose **2 major museums** plus a couple of lower-cost sights
